platform.description: The platform of the environment; null until known.

runtime.description: The .NET RID of the environment; null until known.

kind.description: "mcmod" for a package as defined by the lip Package Protocol. Other kinds record packages of formats the protocol does not define; an implementation that does not know a kind must not install, uninstall or update that package, and must keep its entry unchanged.

explicit.description: Whether a request named the package (as opposed to a dependency).

chain.description: The sources followed to reach the package. The first is what an update requests again.

ref.description: The source, including its variant and ref (e.g. "github.com/o/r#client@branch:main"). A local path of a request is recorded as the file: URI of its absolute path.

target.description: The index of the target selected in the meta package reached here; null when a concrete package is reached.

commit.description: For a remote repository: the commit its archive was at.

archiveKey.description: The archive name: <repo>@<version> for a git archive selected through a version tag with no ref or the ref <version>; <repo>@rev:<commit> for any other git archive; the URL without its fragment; the file: URI of a local file or directory; for a file or directory inside another archive, the archive name of that archive, "!" and the local path without its leading "./".

archive.description: The archive identifier of the package; null when unknown (packages taken over from tooth_lock.json).

files.description: The owned files, workspace-relative and '/'-separated; files under plugins/ are recorded in the mods/ form.

url.description: Where the ZIP file was read from: the https URL it was downloaded from, without its fragment; the file: URI of the absolute path of a local file; or null for a ZIP file inside another archive, which is obtained again through the chain.

path.description: For a directory inside the ZIP file: the path of the directory, without a leading or trailing '/'.
The path of the directory in the commit, without a leading or trailing '/'; "" for the root.
The absolute path of the directory archive, or of the directory inside it, on the local file system.
